hero.titleHtml: Win the deal before the first call.
hero.lede: For B2B companies and services firms, executive authority and business-media coverage that survive procurement, shorten sales cycles and give your champion something to forward internally.

sections.label: The problem
sections.titleHtml: B2B buyers do their homework silently.
sections.lede: By the time a prospect talks to sales, they have already searched you, your founder and your category. What they find decides whether the call happens at all.

items.text: Procurement finds nothing to de-risk the decision
“How do we know you’re legit?” starts every call
Your champion cannot sell you internally without proof
AI vendor-comparison queries skip uncovered companies

sections.label: Our approach
sections.lede: Executive features, industry commentary and case-backed coverage in the business media your buyers cite, so every stakeholder who searches you finds reassurance, not silence.

items.title: Executive features
items.text: Leadership profiles that give the firm a credible public face.

items.title: Industry commentary
items.text: Your take in the trade and business press your buyers read.

items.title: Panel & podcast circuit
items.text: The industry conversations where authority is assigned.

items.title: Milestone coverage
items.text: Clients won, expansions, partnerships, on the record.

sections.titleHtml: No retainers. No vague promises. No surprises.
sections.lede: PR has a reputation problem: monthly retainers, invisible work, reports full of “activity.” We run it differently, you know exactly what you are getting before you spend a rupee.
items: The outlet mix is mapped and agreed before you commit
Every story is written for you, nothing goes out without your sign-off
You get every live link in a proof report, ready to share
Placements are permanent, indexed on Google, citable by AI platforms
No long lock-ins, engage per placement or per campaign

items.title: Press Releases
items.text: News coverage, written and indexed where people check.

items.title: Magazine Features
items.text: Covers and editorial spreads that turn visibility into status.

items.q: Our buyers are a niche audience. Does mass media help?
items.a: The mix skews to trade and business outlets your buyers cite, mass media adds the Google-proof layer for procurement.

items.q: Can PR really shorten sales cycles?
items.a: Coverage answers the trust questions before the call, so conversations start further down the funnel. Clients consistently report warmer first meetings.

items.q: Who from our team needs to be involved?
items.a: Usually just the founder or one executive, for about an hour per placement.
